title: Emerging Lines: MXenes & Multifunctional Nanoparticles
descriptionHtml:
Development multifunctional nanoparticles

Our research focuses on the design and engineering of hybrid nanomaterials that combine multiple components through conjugation or form single nano-objects with distinct chemical domains. By tailoring these complex architectures, we aim to unlock synergistic properties for advanced biomedical applications. On the fundamental side, we investigate new functional materials with unconventional compositions and crystal structures. We explore how composition, interfacial interactions, and assembly architecture govern the hybrid’s optical, thermal, and magnetic behaviors.
